payload.text: `actual_days` is the signed day-count primitive underlying every `DayCount` accrual: it returns `(end - start).whole_days()` as an `i64`, so it is signed (negative when end precedes start) and counts whole days only. This signedness is what makes `year_fraction` anti-symmetric under interval reversal; it is the sole bridge from the `time::Date` calendar type into the ACT/365 and ACT/360 numerators. Pure: reads two dates, returns i64, no side effects.
